newsitem.title: BRAZIL: INSTANT VIEW - Brazil's October trade deficit.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Brazil's October trade deficit.

text.p: Following is a selection of reactions to the announcement of Brazil's $1.308 billion October trade deficit.

"It's worse than expected. It confirms that trade is indeed deteriorating and imports are growing faster than the economy, while exports are sluggish due to a strong currency. It raises questions about how fast Brazil can afford to grow."
"It's a high number, above our expectations. But to see a trend, we really must wait for next month's trade balance."

"The number is very bad. We were expecting a $900 million deficit, well below this figure. What is worrisome is the weakness of exports, which are gradually deteriorating. The market will have reasons to continue speculative and nervous over the next months."

"There will be an initial negative reaction from the markets, but the number in itself is not that relevant. November is likely to show a lower deficit than October, but the government will not be able to avoid a (large) deficit at year's end."
